name: baltor-library
description: Search the Baltor library and stage a selected item or complete package with exact byte checks

interface.shortDescription: Search Baltor and stage exact files.
interface.longDescription: A first-party skill with a Python standard library client. It searches the Baltor library, checks versions and digests, and stages a selected item or package in a new folder. It never installs or runs what it downloads.
interface.defaultPrompt: Search the Baltor library for material this task needs, then stage the one item I select with its exact byte checks.
